title: The Black Lake
survival_class: Unsecure . / Hostile Environment . / Low Entity Count .
physical_identity: Circular lake of boiling asphalt tar (95 C) with hot charcoal sand islands, burned/sunken wooden piers, in perpetual grey fog, ringed by unreachable dunes.
scale_topology: Finite outdoor lake; 50 m untraversable ring before ~15 m dunes; piers 2-6 m up.
anomalies: Platforms sink like quicksand then burn
lighting_sound: Perpetual greying fog; flames and bubbling tar; sound not stated beyond bubbling and fire.

entities.name: Collagen Leviathans
entities.behavior: Fossil-bone eel creatures leap from tar to grab wanderers on islands/piers

entrances.method: Stand under tar dripping in boiler rooms
entrances.quote: Standing overhead these dripping tars will teleport oneself to Level 41.

entrances.method: Slimy black walls; too much on hands
entrances.quote: Getting too much of this substance on one's hands will trigger travel to this level.

entrances.method: Tar-water crack under submerged carpet in house
entrances.quote: Interacting with this substance will bring one to Level 41.

entrances.method: Fully submerge in an island tar pit
entrances.quote: fully submerging oneself within it will drop individuals into this level.

entrances.method: Follow rivers until black, then enter
entrances.quote: Entering the rivers after this change occurs will cause individuals to end up here.

entrances.method: Noclip through tar-covered rotten trees with leaves
entrances.quote: Noclipping through any tar covered or overly rotten trees that still possess leaves in Level 309

exits.method: Broken window of submerged navy vessel bridge
exits.quote: Clambering inside the broken window of a submerged bridge for a USA navy vessel.

exits.method: Booster nozzles of upside-down NASA shuttle
exits.quote: Somehow getting oneself into the booster nozzles of an upside down, NASA space shuttle.
Finding an odd barn door on a stone plinth and going through it.

exits.method: Submerged lighthouse gallery; tamper with beacon
exits.quote: then tampering with the functional, flickering beacon within it.

signature_mechanic: Boiling tar lake traversed only by hot islands and burning piers; Leviathans ambush at edges; four unique landmark exits.
verticality: Piers 2-6 m above ground; dunes ~15 m as unreachable backdrop.
conflicts_notes: Footnotes 1-7 missing from snapshot. Link list includes the Macchina, the Lost, Level 40, 42 not in body. Class says Low Entity Count while Leviathans hunt.

key_quotes.quote: perpetual greying fog that masks most of the environment
physical touch with this tar, even without direct skin contact, can cause burns and boils
impossible to reach anywhere closer than 50 metres of the dunes
they will jump out of the lake
Only one of each of these objects exist within the lake
